policy_checks.market_rate: ML2025-03: 87% applicable LTV/LTC, 1.15 DSCR; all limiting criteria still apply.
policy_checks.cash_out: ML2025-03 leaves Criterion 10 unchanged. MAP3.7.11: greater of 80% of value or cost to refinance; no automatic 87% cash-out.
policy_checks.seasoning: MAP3.7.2.B: at least one full month applicable DSCR to apply, three consecutive months before endorsement, with documentation and safeguards.
policy_checks.middle_income: ML2026-01 supersedes ML2025-02; qualifying 221d4 only, 90% LTC and1.11DSCR, general 50% units at <=120%AMI and recorded restriction normally >=10years. Program and exceptions must be checked.
policy_checks.btr: Issued ML2026-12;221d4 new construction;223f CO<3years;5+units;cohesive contiguous site;no individual sales or partial releases.
policy_checks.thresholds: ML2026-05:2026baseSR$20,406 before applicable adjustments/tests;large-loan threshold$130M. Neither is a universal loan/repair cap.
